title: Âm cuối -s
tip: Tiếng Việt không có phụ âm cuối /s/, /z/ nên rất dễ bỏ. Số nhiều (customers, tests) và động từ ngôi thứ ba (works, uses) đều cần âm này. Đọc chậm, cố ý bật nhẹ âm 'xì' hoặc 'dz' ở cuối từ trước khi sang từ sau.

sentences.text: Our customers book tickets on their phones.
She reviews my pull requests every morning.
The service sends emails when a payment fails.
He works on two projects and helps the testers.
My team writes clean code and fixes bugs fast.
The app uses three databases and two caches.
Each request takes about two seconds.
Our users really like the new features.

title: Âm cuối -ed
tip: -ed có 3 cách đọc: /t/ sau âm vô thanh (fixed, helped), /d/ sau âm hữu thanh (solved, changed), /ɪd/ sau t hoặc d (added, started). Bỏ âm này thì người nghe hiểu là bạn đang nói về hiện tại.

sentences.text: I fixed the bug and deployed the new version.
We started the project last year.
She solved the problem and helped the team.
I added a cache and reduced the response time.
They changed the design after the meeting.
I learned a lot when I worked on that system.
The test failed because the data looked wrong.
We migrated the old services and improved the logs.

title: Cụm phụ âm cuối
tip: Từ như tests, requests, results kết thúc bằng hai, ba phụ âm liền nhau. Đừng nuốt bớt: tests là /tests/, không phải 'tét' hay 'text'. Tách chậm từng âm (tes-t-s) rồi nối lại cho liền.

sentences.text: I wrote unit tests and integration tests.
The results of the tests were good.
We handle thousands of requests per second.
The cost of the cloud is our biggest concern.
She asked the client about the next steps.
The text and the tests are different things.
I checked the last commits before the release.
Our first product was a small chat app.

title: Phụ âm cuối rõ ràng
tip: Tiếng Việt có ít phụ âm cuối và thường không bật hơi. Tiếng Anh cần nghe rõ âm cuối: cache là /kæʃ/ (kết thúc bằng 'sh', không phải 'kít'), code /koʊd/, job /dʒɑːb/. Giữ đúng nguyên âm, rồi khép âm cuối rõ ràng.

sentences.text: We put a cache in front of the database.
Please check the code before the build.
My job is to fix the bug on the web page.
The cache made the page much faster.
I need a quick fix for this issue.
Let me share my screen and walk you through it.
The log shows a bad request.
We use Spring Boot for the backend.

title: Âm th và số đếm
tip: Âm /θ/ (think, thirty, three): đặt đầu lưỡi giữa hai hàm răng rồi thổi hơi, không đọc thành 't' hay 's'. Số -teen nhấn âm sau (thir-TEEN), số -ty nhấn âm đầu (THIR-ty), nên đừng đọc đều hai âm.

sentences.text: It reduced the response time by thirty percent.
I think this is the third time it failed.
We have thirteen tests and thirty users.
The meeting is on Thursday at three.
Thank you for the clear method.
Both of them worked with the other team.
Fifteen or fifty? I said fifty.
The truth is that the growth was healthy.
